title: transformData error message
body: Can we put a more explicit error message when nothing is returned in the transformData function

comments.body: I had the issue when trying to check the content passed to the widget with only a console.log, would it be possible to handle that by taking the original content if nothing is returned ?

> taking the original content if nothing is returned ?

I decided to rather throw an explicit error message if you're not returning anything. Using the original data hides too much things. If you just want to debug, you can then just return the original data.
I totally fine with it, was just and idea :smile:
